name: Hallow's End: a Brill training fire doused for Fire Training goes out before it relights
contract: 'Fire Training' 11449 from Masked Orphan Matron 23973 in Brill (area 159) asks for five Headless Horseman - Fire (DND) 23537 credits; five of those training fires burn north of Brill during Hallow's End (event 12), each carrying Headless Horseman - Fire 42074. A Water Bucket 32971 thrown onto a burning fire splashes it with Water Splash 42348, gives one credit and puts that fire out. Before the fix the fire's script relit it on its next update, so the fire never went out and the same fire could be doused five times (#8397); it now stays out for its 5 s relight delay and then burns again. Client visuals are untested.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the event spawns live
11449 is in the log with no fire put out
Walk north to the Brill training fires
All five Brill training fires burn
SETUP: a Water Bucket from the barrel
Throw the bucket onto training fire 240025
The doused fire gives one credit
Let the fire script run a few updates
DISCRIMINATING: the doused fire stays out
The doused fire relights after its delay
